environment.host: Intel i5-6200U, 2 physical cores, 4 logical processors, 12 GB RAM, CPU-only

full_quality_screen.method: one pass over all six answerable v2 contexts; explicit thread candidates used one excluded warm-up, while the earlier runtime-default smoke pass did not; model load time is excluded from generation metrics

focused_paired_comparison.execution: three alternating default/four-thread pairs with identical 143-token prompts and 372-token generations
focused_paired_comparison.runner_reload_observation: Switching the thread option caused 35-61 second model reloads. Load time was kept separate from generation throughput.

decision: Retain the Ollama runtime default. Two threads were slower, while the exploratory four-thread gain was small relative to observed run variation and required full CPU saturation.
